iterations.agentPrompt:
# Behavioral Drift Report (Iteration 1)

The modern rewrite differs from the legacy baseline on the following flows.

## Flow: TodoMVC singular items-left grammar (`todomvc-singular-counter`)
| Kind | Key | Expected (Legacy) | Actual (Modern) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value_mismatch | items_left | 1 item left | 1 items left |

## Flow: TodoMVC whitespace-only todo guard (`todomvc-whitespace-guard`)
| Kind | Key | Expected (Legacy) | Actual (Modern) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value_mismatch | todo_count | 1 | 2 |

## Flow: TodoMVC clear completed preserves active todos (`todomvc-clear-completed`)
| Kind | Key | Expected (Legacy) | Actual (Modern) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value_mismatch | remaining_counter | 1 item left | 0 items left |

Fix the behavioral drift in the modern app without breaking other flows. Only inspect and edit files inside the current working directory, keep changes minimal, and finish immediately after applying the fix.
